root_cause.text: The conditional expression in `filesystems_freeze_callback()` that gates which superblocks are frozen was inverted – checking `freeze_all_ptr` instead of `!freeze_all_ptr` – causing all filesystems to be frozen when the freeze-all mode was not intended, leading to spurious WARN_ON_ONCE() in `__set_task_frozen()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch reverses `if (freeze_all_ptr && ...)` to `if (!freeze_all_ptr && ...)` in `fs/super.c`. The commit message states the check was "reverse" and "causes all file systems to be frozen when filesystem_freeze_enabled is false."

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch reverses `if (freeze_all_ptr && ...)` to `if (!freeze_all_ptr && ...)` in `fs/super.c`. The commit message states the check was "reverse" and "causes all file systems to be frozen when filesystem_freeze_enabled is false."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix inverted condition to correctly skip freezing only for non-global freeze on filesystems without power freeze support.
intent_record.what: Changed the condition from `if (freeze_all_ptr && !(sb->s_type->fs_flags & FS_POWER_FREEZE))` to `if (!freeze_all_ptr && !(sb->s_type->fs_flags & FS_POWER_FREEZE))` by adding a logical NOT operator before `freeze_all_ptr`.
intent_record.how: The function now returns early (skips freezing) only when `freeze_all_ptr` is NULL (i.e., not a global freeze) AND the filesystem does not have the FS_POWER_FREEZE flag. Previously, it returned early when `freeze_all_ptr` was non-NULL (global freeze) and the flag was missing, which was incorrect.

grouping_result.intent: Fix inverted condition to correctly skip freezing only for non-global freeze on filesystems without power freeze support.

relevance_review.reason: Group 0 directly fixes the inverted conditional that is the root cause of the vulnerability.

candidates.rationale: The condition is inverted: it checks freeze_all_ptr instead of !freeze_all_ptr, causing filesystems without FS_POWER_FREEZE to be skipped during non-global freeze (freeze_all_ptr false), but in freeze-all mode (freeze_all_ptr true), it incorrectly skips the skip, leading to unintended freezing of all filesystems and triggering a WARN_ON_ONCE.

vuln_statements.explanation: The conditional expression is inverted: it checks freeze_all_ptr instead of !freeze_all_ptr. This causes all filesystems to be frozen when freeze_all is false (non-global freeze), leading to spurious WARN_ON_ONCE() in __set_task_frozen(). The correct condition should skip freezing only when freeze_all is false and the filesystem lacks FS_POWER_FREEZE.
